info.title: StatCite API
info.description: Official economic statistics with full citations, built for AI agents. Every numeric response includes a citation object (source, dataset, series_id, source_url, license, attribution, retrieved_at, citation_text). Free, no auth, read-only. MCP endpoint at https://statcite.com/mcp.

get.summary: Endpoint index — service info and list of available /v1 routes
List the curated indicator registry (48 keys, 42 active)

active.description: False for the six permanently-disabled FRED-reserved keys — they are recognized but always decline (added 1.4.2).

disabled_reason.description: Present only when active is false: why the key declines and what to use instead.

get.summary: Official values for an indicator + country, with citation

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Registry key, e.g. inflation_cpi, gdp_growth, govt_debt_gdp

parameters.name: strict_source
parameters.description: Reproducibility mode: if the primary source fails, return an error instead of serving the fallback source. Fallback responses carry fallback_used: true and are served no-store.

get.summary: Raw series by explicit id (worldbank/…, imf/…, dbnomics/…; fred/… is recognized but always declines — FRED is disabled)

parameters.name: strict_source
parameters.description: Reproducibility mode for registry-key ids: never substitute the fallback source. No effect on explicit source-prefixed ids.

get.summary: Search indicators and datasets by topic
Headline indicators for a country, each with its own citation
Verify a claimed figure against the official series
get.description: Returns verdict match | close | mismatch | cannot_verify with the official value, difference, diagnostics (wrong year, percent-vs-decimal, unit scaling), and the citation for the correct number.

parameters.name: indicator
parameters.description: Registry key or explicit series id

parameters.name: strict_source
parameters.description: Never verify against a fallback source — error instead. Without strict_source, a verify served from a transient-failure fallback returns cannot_verify (with the fallback value as indicative); a fallback for a series the primary permanently lacks is judged normally with disclosure.

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: Historical IMF-vintage verification: judge the claim against the dated IMF WEO edition resolved from this date (e.g. '2019-04', '2019') instead of today's live data. Resolution is a CONSERVATIVE month calendar (editions flip May 1 / Nov 1), not the IMF's exact release days — a date late in a release month resolves to the previous edition even if the new one already existed (the response says so, with an exact-pinning escape hatch via get_series dated ids). Always verifies against a dated WEO edition, even for indicators whose live primary is World Bank WDI or the IMF Fiscal Monitor — see as_of.source_changed_for_as_of. Recent editions serve from the IMF's own dated vintage dataflows (api.imf.org) first, with DBnomics's dated editions as the deep archive; the citation names which one served. Only supported for the six WEO-dated registry indicators (gdp_growth, current_account_gdp, govt_debt_gdp, fiscal_balance_gdp, govt_revenue_gdp, govt_expenditure_gdp); rejects with advice otherwise. Impossible calendar dates are rejected, never normalized.

post.summary: Verify a batch of claimed figures (fact-check a whole draft) — the API's only non-GET route
post.description: Extract every checkable macro claim from a draft (indicator + country + period + claimed value) and submit up to 15 together. Each claim gets the same verdict engine as /v1/verify; results return in input order with a verdict-count summary. A claim that cannot be resolved reports its error in place without failing the batch. The 15-claim cap reflects the free-tier upstream subrequest budget — split larger drafts into batches.

claims.description: The claims extracted from the draft, in the order they appear (max 15 per call).

indicator.description: Registry key (inflation_cpi, gdp_growth, …) or explicit series id (worldbank/FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG, imf/NGDP_RPCH, dbnomics/…). fred/… ids are recognized but always decline — FRED is disabled.

country.description: ISO3/ISO2 code or English name; required for registry indicators / worldbank series

period.description: Period of the claim, usually a year, e.g. 2024

claimed_value.description: The value as claimed, in the series' own units

tolerance_abs.description: Optional absolute tolerance in series units

revision_check.description: Present on mismatch verdicts for indicators with a dated IMF WEO source: the claim re-judged against the PREVIOUS WEO edition. matches_previous_vintage=true means the figure was likely accurate when written and has since been revised - a revision event, not necessarily an author error. status 'unavailable' = the previous edition could not be retrieved; no judgment is offered.

next_edition_expected.description: Calendar expectation ('October 2026'), not an announced date.

as_of.description: Verify this claim against the IMF WEO/Fiscal Monitor edition current as of this date (e.g. '2019-04') instead of today's live data — only for the 6 WEO-dated registry indicators (served from the IMF's own vintage dataflows first, DBnomics dated editions as the deep archive).

strict_source.description: Apply reproducibility mode to every claim in the batch: never verify against a fallback source — such claims error in place. Without it, a claim served from a transient-failure fallback returns cannot_verify with the fallback value as indicative.

200.description: Batch verification result: verdict-count summary plus per-claim results in input order

results.description: One entry per claim, in input order. ok:true entries carry the full verification payload; ok:false entries carry a per-claim error message (errors never sink the rest of the batch).

note.description: Present when some claims were verified against IMF WEO/Fiscal Monitor projections rather than outturns

405.description: Method not allowed — this endpoint accepts POST only; GET returns usage advice

415.description: Unsupported media type — set content-type: application/json

get.summary: Adjust an amount for inflation between two years (CPI ratio)

200.description: Adjusted amount with method and citation

get.summary: Convert currencies with official reference rates
get.description: ECB daily reference rates (~30 majors, since 1999) or World Bank official annual-average rates (~90 more currencies) via a USD bridge. The response states precision (daily | annual_average | mixed) and the exact method.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD (daily) or YYYY (annual average); omit for latest

get.summary: Data sources, licenses, and required attribution lines
Compare one indicator across every official source in its chain (per-source values, citations, spread)

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Optional year; default = latest period all responding sources share

200.description: Per-source values with citations and a spread; differences are methodological, never a source error

get.summary: Service status with live upstream probes (edge-cached ~120s)

upstreams.description: Per-upstream probe results: ok flag and probe latency in ms.

Citation.description: Every numeric payload carries one of these. Reproduce citation_text when presenting the number.

fallback_used.description: Present and true when the primary source failed and a fallback source served this result — the value may reflect a different statistical definition. Absent on primary-source responses.

fallback_reason.description: Present only alongside fallback_used: 'transient' means the primary failed temporarily and may serve a different value for the same query once recovered (verify_stat demotes such verifies to cannot_verify); 'definitive' means the primary permanently lacks this series/country (e.g. Taiwan in WDI), so the fallback is that combination's stable serving source and verifies are judged normally with disclosure.

is_projection.description: True when the matched official observation is an IMF WEO/Fiscal Monitor estimate/projection, not a final outturn. Kept for compatibility; observation_status carries the finer-grained classification.

observation_status.description: Honest status of the matched observation. 'actual': a series StatCite classifies as outturn data (registry World Bank indicators not flagged as modeled, explicit worldbank/ WDI ids), subject to routine revision. 'modeled_estimate' (added 1.4.1): the registry flags this indicator as a modeled series — e.g. the World Bank's ILO-modeled unemployment and labor-force-participation estimates — a published figure, but a model output, not a measured outturn. 'estimate_or_actual': IMF WEO/Fiscal Monitor observation before the projection boundary — the IMF's true latest-actual year varies by country and is not exposed by the data path, so recent values may be staff estimates; never read this as a confirmed actual. 'projection': at/after the heuristic boundary. 'unknown': no observation matched the period, or the series is an explicit id outside StatCite's classification (arbitrary DBnomics series can be forecast datasets — consult the source).

status_method.description: How observation_status was determined: 'horizon_heuristic' for IMF WEO/Fiscal Monitor series (boundary derived from the response's own data — the payload's projection horizon on the DataMapper channel, the dataset-code vintage year on the DBnomics channel; a heuristic, not IMF per-country metadata); 'as_published' otherwise.

fallback_used.description: Present and true when the official value came from a fallback source because the primary failed. A transient primary failure demotes the verdict to cannot_verify with the fallback value reported as indicative (a substitute source can differ by definition or vintage far beyond the verdict bands, and the primary may recover and serve a different number); when the primary permanently lacks the series/country, the fallback is the stable serving source and the verdict is judged normally with disclosure. Absent otherwise.

as_of.description: Present when the as_of parameter was used: historical IMF-VINTAGE verification — the verdict was checked against a dated IMF WEO edition, not today's live data. Absent otherwise.

requested.description: The as_of date as passed by the caller.

resolved_vintage.description: The IMF WEO edition (YYYY-MM) resolved from it.

resolution.description: How the vintage was resolved: a conservative month calendar (editions flip May 1 / Nov 1), NOT the IMF's exact release days — a date late in a release month resolves to the previous edition even if the new one had already been published; a note discloses this for dates inside release months.

verification_scope.description: What was verified against: the IMF WEO historical archive, the only dated-vintage source this server has.

normal_primary_source.description: The source the live (non-as_of) path serves this indicator from first (e.g. 'World Bank WDI', 'IMF Fiscal Monitor (via the DataMapper API)').

source_changed_for_as_of.description: True when the live primary differs from the WEO archive by source or IMF database — a claim originally made from the live primary can legitimately differ from the WEO edition for methodological reasons, not only because of revisions.

Unprocessable.description: Request understood but not servable — the message includes suggestions (closest countries, available year ranges)
